Disagreement: The SSAC_ANALOG master makes most Settings Input: EngMin, FaultSubValue, Hysteresis, Mode, and limits HH to UR. Yet HHH, EngMax and Config.Alarms are In/Out.
Why it matters: The transmitter faceplate can write only the HHH limit, and commissioning can write EngMax but not EngMin - half the OI-01 path. The master is inconsistent with itself, so this is a library fix, and it affects every project using SSAC_ANALOG.

Disagreement: The SSAC_VALVE_SV master has Control.Cmd and Control.Mode as Output.
Why it matters: Fine for the library. On SafeStack, Control.Mode is overwritten every scan by FB4 (Status), and Control.Cmd returns to 0 on PLC restart, which an Output-only DPE never sees. Project-level override or accept.

Disagreement: HMI setpoints, HoldTol, ManualMode and Estop.Valves are Output; cross table v2 recommended In/Out.
Why it matters: After a PLC restart the HMI keeps showing its last write, not the start values the PLC returned to. Most visible on Estop.Valves.

Disagreement: ConnSeq.HMI_Ack is In/Out; cross table v2 said Output.
Why it matters: Harmless. Align either the rule or the config.
